It's a bit strange
Jul 2019 • Family
I was in Danang with my family and when we asked our cab driver for any recommendations for vegetarian street food, he bought us to Thuy Vegetarian Restaurant. I waited for a while, and saw the menu had everything which is essentially a meat substitute. Eventually, there were a couple of ladies sitting at the tables who signaled to me to order. They were sitting there like bosses so I just assumed they are the owners. Once I ordered, they started screaming at the staff, I just assumed that they were placing my order, and maybe that's the way it works. But it definitely didn't feel right. Eventually got my bahn mi and pho. Both were awful, but it was cheap. This place felt very strange, and I wouldn't come back again.

A total scam and filthy. Lengthy but worth the read.
Sep 2018 • Couples
For some unknown reason this place was recommended on culture trip and by the hostel we’re staying at for a great and cheap vegetarian eat. We went there for a light dinner and were sat on a dirty table with a used water cup that the waiter flipped back upside down onto the “clean” cup tray and proceeded to stand there silent and pointing at the menu until we ordered, which was very uncomfortable and already paving the way for a horrible experience. We had to use google translate to tell the waiter that we would take some time to chose our meals and then he finally moved from over the top of us.
We ordered the pyramid rice dumpling, and the fried rice pancakes which state on the menu they come out with 2. A bowl of Pho and a noodle soup dish. The meals came out concerningly fast and they gave us a plate (approx 5) of the dumplings. 
We ate our meals and all’s well and good. We count up how much it should be according to the menu (55,000) but when I handed her the money she brought over a written down receipt charging us for each dumpling individually and the 2 rice pancakes individually so double what was stated on the menu. Not clearly stating on the menu anywhere the quantities they will bring out or how much it actually costs it was a complete scam and none of them speak English to discuss what was going on. 
This whole experience was infuriating and they knew exactly why we were angry but knew we couldn’t do anything about it. 
Avoid at ALL COSTS it’s not worth it. Absolutely disgusted.

Quick lunch
Mar 2017 • Solo
I had been to this place a year ago amd promised myself to never return. However it so happened that I accidently foundyself having lunch there and hoped it would be a better experience.
Firstly I had to ask the waitress to clean the table as it was filthy and still had sauce and left over from previous guests.
The floor was littered with used paper napkins and food.

I ordered a ginko juice which never arrived. Ordered a papaya salad and asked for it to be served without the mock beef. Surely it arrived with mock meat and I asked to have it removed.
The steamed rolled rice pancakes arrived shortly after and they did have some kind of mock meat inside, even so the menu does not mention that.
The sauces on the table all have msg and aspartame in it and it is likely that all dishes are prepared using those.
The owner seems to enjoy screaming at her staff (hopefully not customers) as I could hear loud scolding voices in the vack of the restaurant.
The service was functional at best.
Overall an unpleasent expereince and I will definitively not return.
